description: Convert subtitle cue timestamps and text between SRT and WebVTT while preserving cue order. UTF-8 text up to 32 MiB. Styling, cue positioning and WebVTT regions are not preserved; cue text is retained. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: subtitle_convert
title: Convert SRT and VTT subtitles
